caption: The drawing features a rectangular textile design with an indented top edge. The composition includes a central motif of a symmetrical, ornate floral pattern created with a medium blue background and off-white decorative elements. The flower at the center has six large petals, surrounded by a complex arrangement of stylized leaves and scrollwork, all rendered in off-white. The blue areas provide the negative space that defines these intricate patterns. The border of the textile is framed with a zigzag or wave-like pattern, also in off-white, running along the edges. The background within the border and outside the central medallion consists of diagonal lines and hatching in off-white on blue. The overall color scheme is limited to medium blue and off-white tones, with the floral and geometric patterns contrasting sharply against the background. There are no other objects or color variations outside these elements.
title: Coverlet
